depicted_variant: Rooster herald crowing at dawn while indistinct spirits flee his call.

visual_requirements.description: Rooster with one head, two wings and two legs, ordinary animal size
Crowing announces the flight of spirits, shown recoiling and fleeing away
Dawn as rooster opens the day in the Basque story

aura: The physically reacting fleeing spirits make the rooster herald supernatural (c02); dawn accompanies the crow c06, with no luminous aura or sound ribbons.
artistic_choices: Select protective herald c02 rather than mixing malevolent Gaiskine c03 or pillow-feather illness omen c04 into one scene.
Secondary spirits are deliberately indistinct translucent shapes with no defined heads, limbs, costume, species or lamiñak anatomy invented; translucency is an editorial cue for unspecified spirits.
Ordinary rooster size; ground-level close perspective makes him dominate. Black russet feathers and stone outcrop are editorial color and composition, not claimed breed or specific locale.
Dawn is an associated moment c06, not a literal rooster creating sunbeams, fire or weather.
prompt: ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Oilar, the rooster herald of Basque legend whose crow announces the fleeing of spirits. ANATOMY: ONE living ordinary-size ROOSTER with ONE head, TWO natural dark eyes, one red comb and red wattles, one normal pointed beak, TWO feathered wings, TWO bird legs with normal rooster feet and ONE arched tail of feathers. Dense black and russet natural feathers, NO horns, human face, fangs, claws replacing feet or extra eyes [oilar-c01]. MOMENT: CROW FORCEFULLY toward the sky and viewer from a low stone ridge, beak wide OPEN, neck extended and chest thrust forward, both wings half-spread in strong bracing action. His call has just made several SPIRITS FLEE: show three large indistinct translucent grey-black spirit shapes recoil and stream AWAY from the rooster toward the dark background, clearly separate from his body. Spirits are secondary vague forms without specific heads, eyes, limbs or costumes; no invented lamiñak anatomy. Their retreat must be an unmistakably supernatural response to the crow rather than ordinary fog [oilar-c02]. POWER: spirit-repelling crow, shown by fleeing spirits ONLY, no visible sound circles, magic beams, aura, neon, runes, fire breath, cracked rock or weather control. SCALE & CAMERA: extreme LOW GROUND camera inches below the stone, rooster face, open beak, chest, two braced feet and arched tail dominate the square; normal-size rooster, not a giant, no farmyard animals. Spirit shapes remain behind him. LIGHT & WEATHER: first harsh amber DAWN cuts across near-black night, a single low rising sunlight rim on black feathers and red comb, deep walnut shadows, no decorative postcard sky. SURFACE: tactile damp coarse feathers, worn stone, fine cold dew. SETTING: rocky rural ground at dawn, minimal landscape, no coop, fence or barn [oilar-c06]. MOOD: overwhelming defiant supernatural herald driving unseen beings away, dangerous awe and fierce action, never an ordinary farm rooster portrait, cute pet, static animal, landscape or cockfight. HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, frame, border or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or toes; no film, game, anime or comic designs; no people, nudity or gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, magical ribbons or floating glyphs. Square, high contrast premium painterly brushwork with clean subject silhouette readable at 200 pixels.
